blockers.what_was_tried: Four candidate certified sets: (1) the projection of one admissible ladder history; (2) the full realizable set (the plan's Real, Finding 3); (3) the cell at one representative state per (q, kappa)-class; (4) a set confined to a single state's cell. blockers.why_it_failed: Dmax is the union of certAdmK-certified sets and its own certification is unavailable (Phase 9's recorded exclusion: certStabK and certBoxK are biconditionals, so only the four monotone conditions survive a union). Candidate 1 fails certBoxK, whose backward direction needs a global box bit that one chain cannot refute. Candidate 2 fails certStabK: stab_mem_tpOf_iff makes the stab bit a datum of one world state while certStabK's fibre is taken over the whole (q, kappa)-class. Candidates 3 and 4 fail certBiInfK, which forbids confining a certified set to one state's cell. The gap between (5) and (2) is exactly the constancy of cellAt on K-classes, which is Phase 13's Goal and which Phase 13 derives from (S) and (C'); the plan's Finding 3 records the same dependency in the other direction. The depth stratification Phase 11's Scope Hypothesis offers as the escape does not escape: at depth d the argument calls the lift (C') at depth d-1, so the induction is simultaneous in (S) and (C') and cannot be split across phases whose Depends on edges run one way.
